net_manifest_status.observable_asof_rule: ok | partial | missing | unreconciled (measured, never hardcoded) | AUDIT COORDINATE ONLY: COLLECTION-TIME INFRASTRUCTURE metadata, scoped to this day's own index row; not historical market state and never a feature

net_reconciled.observable_asof_rule: true when the net reconciliation verified this day's files, manifests and rebuilt index row | AUDIT COORDINATE ONLY: COLLECTION-TIME INFRASTRUCTURE metadata, scoped to this day's own reconciliation; not historical market state and never a feature

raw_n_pit_symbols.observable_asof_rule: raw symbols that are PIT eligible, measured for built days

raw_n_pit_symbols_full_window.observable_asof_rule: PIT names with ANY admitted bar in the declared window [565,965], including off-hours-only names. This is the COVERAGE population and is deliberately NOT the board population: deriving coverage from the RTH-trimmed frame manufactured false gaps (2025-02-03 NTZ has exactly one bar at etm 961 / 16:01 ET, PIT-present, and was dropped entirely)

raw_n_symbols.observable_asof_rule: raw symbols observed in RTH (24h lane), measured for built days

raw_roster_cross_feed_witnessed_n.observable_asof_rule: whole-day count of PIT names classified as cross-feed WITNESSED: a non-SIP source preserved the bar the SIP pull did not reproduce. Precedence: witnessed is tested BEFORE the generic API zero, otherwise this class is unreachable and always 0. RETROSPECTIVE proxy only, never a SIP rank input, never a market claim

raw_roster_missing_n.observable_asof_rule: PIT-eligible names with zero raw rows after the acquisition, excluding names the acquisition verified absent (zero bars / no RTH / invalid symbol) | RETROSPECTIVE ONLY: whole-day PIT hole count over the completed session

raw_roster_missing_unresolved_n.observable_asof_rule: PIT names with zero raw rows that no source verified absent: a genuine missing confirmed trader | RETROSPECTIVE ONLY: whole-day unresolved missing-trader count over the completed session

raw_roster_no_sip_bar_also_witnessed_n.observable_asof_rule: whole-day count of PIT names that are BOTH an API zero and cross-feed witnessed. Published so the overlap is explicit: a witnessed name is classified as WITNESSED (the more specific fact) but remains an API zero on the SIP request axis

raw_roster_verified_absent_n.observable_asof_rule: whole-day count of PIT names with no bar in the DECLARED STORED BAR SOURCES (roster `unavailable`), or whose spelling is unrequestable. This is an OBSERVATION statement only: an absent bar is NOT evidence of an absent trade, and nothing here infers one. On 2025-02-03 DXR printed 24 times / 501 shares on the SIP TRADE endpoint while the SIP minute-bar pull returned zero, so data was uncaptured, not silent. A syntax-unrequestable spelling is tracked separately

raw_roster_verified_no_sip_bar_n.observable_asof_rule: whole-day count of unobserved PIT names that are API ZEROS (sip_coverage.symbols_zero_bars), counted by set MEMBERSHIP rather than by class: a cross-feed-witnessed name is also an API zero (the missing SIP bar is why it was witnessed) and must still be counted on this request axis. A REQUEST/COVERAGE fact, never a market claim

qualified_floor_source.observable_asof_rule: the day's lane is the 2025-02 clean fallback

rank_eligible.observable_asof_rule: a name is rank-eligible at t only if it is known_by_t, its price and previous close are positive, its gain is outside the suspect split/bad-print band, its previous close is NOT a confirmed >10% discrepancy against the prior session, AND its previous close is a QUALIFIED REFERENCE - not stale and not floor-qualified. Only session-past facts may enter this mask: the whole-day envelope is retrospective and never filters a rank

rank_fresh_2m.observable_asof_rule: competition rank over the fresh_2m population; null when not eligible

rank_known.observable_asof_rule: competition rank over the known population; null when not eligible

rank_unfiltered.observable_asof_rule: competition rank over EVERY name with a known price and a positive denominator, ignoring ALL quality filters INCLUDING an unqualified previous-close reference. Reference-only: on a day whose prior reference is stale or floor-qualified (2025-02-03 references 2023-12-29 because 2025-01-31 is sealed and never read) the raw px/gain and this rank remain stored as a REFERENCE and cannot support a rank-trajectory or era-stability claim

sip_high_day.observable_asof_rule: the provider lane's MAXIMUM RTH bar high for the ticker that day (day max, not the last minute's high), so the envelope compares like with like

unobserved_classes.cross_feed_witnessed_no_sip_bar: a non-SIP source preserved the bar the SIP pull did not reproduce; retrospective proxy only, never a SIP rank input
unobserved_classes.missing_confirmed_same_feed_bar: the ONLY class counted as a hole: no declared source explains the missing bar
unobserved_classes.precedence: tested in this order: verified_no_bar_in_declared_sources, then cross_feed_witnessed_no_sip_bar, then verified_no_sip_bar, then missing_confirmed_same_feed_bar. The witnessed test MUST precede the generic API-zero test because every witnessed name is also an API zero; reversing the order makes the cross-feed class unreachable and its count always 0
unobserved_classes.rule: an absent bar never licenses a 'did not trade' inference; the four classes are statements about observation, not about the market
unobserved_classes.verified_no_bar_in_declared_sources: no bar observed in the declared stored bar sources, or the spelling is unrequestable; NOT a claim that the name did not trade
unobserved_classes.verified_no_sip_bar: SIP accepted the spelling and returned no minute bar; a request/coverage fact
